daily.today_energy: Your vibe is electric today, Sag. There's a restless curiosity bubbling up—lean into it. The universe is basically asking you to explore something new, whether that's a hobby, a conversation, or just a different route home.
daily.love: Vulnerability hits different right now. If you've been holding back on someone, today's energy supports honest words. Single? Your authentic self is genuinely magnetic. Stop trying to fit a mold.
daily.career: Your creative problem-solving is peaked today. That project or situation that felt stuck? You've got fresh perspective. Trust your gut calls, but maybe run the big ones by someone you respect first.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and play, not punishment. Do something that feels good rather than obligatory—dancing, walking, stretching. Mental clarity follows when you actually enjoy what you're doing.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is pulling you toward authenticity. Mercury's moving through your sector of self-expression, so your words hit different—use that power wisely. Expect unexpected conversations that shift your perspective.
weekly.love: Venus is whispering something about vulnerability being your superpower rn. Whether you're single or coupled up, honesty about what you actually need opens doors. Don't overthink the small stuff; your vibe speaks louder than your words.
weekly.career: Your ambitious energy is peaking, but the universe is asking you to zoom out before zooming in. Big picture thinking pays off this week. Collaboration over solo plays brings the most unexpected wins. Trust your instincts on new opportunities.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. The stars suggest moving in ways that feel good rather than punishing. Rest isn't laziness—it's strategic. Hydrate more than usual and pay attention to what actually nourishes you emotionally.
